description: Search Nomads.com for the best cities to live and work remotely. Filters: budget, region, country, internet speed, safety, temperature. Returns at most 100 cities sorted by overall score. Each city includes costs, internet, weather, air quality, safety/cleanliness/healthcare/fun and other 0-5 scores, air conditioning (share of households, availability 1-5), tax burden (tax revenue as % of GDP) and an animated thumbnail video.

max_cost_usd.description: Max monthly cost for a nomad in USD (responses also carry expat, local, family, rent and coworking costs)

region.description: One of: Europe, Asia, North America, Latin America, Africa, Middle East, Oceania

name: search_cities
